Indicator 6 tracks the incidence of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] among prevalent patients with [[atrieflimren]] across Danish regions, municipalities, and health clusters. The standard target for this indicator is strictly set at ≤0.6% [^src1]. Across the reporting periods from 2020/21 to 2024/25, the national incidence has remained relatively stable, hovering around 0.5% before ticking up to 0.6% in the 2024/25 period [^src1], [^src3], [^src4].

**Leaders and Trailers**
In the 2022/23 municipal data, the highest incidences were recorded in [[vallensbaek|Vallensbæk]] (1.5%) [^src2], [[alleroed|Allerød]] (1.3%) [^src1], and [[frederiksvaerk-hundested|Frederiksværk-Hundested]] (1.3%) [^src1]. Conversely, several municipalities reported a 0.0% incidence, including [[solrod]] and [[fanoe]] [^src2], as well as Høje-Taastrup and Ishøj [^src1]. By the 2024/25 reporting period, the highest rates shifted to health clusters and regions, with Klynge VEST recording a significant outlier at 1.1% [^src4]. The lowest rates in 2024/25 were seen in clusters like Sydvestjylland, Lillebælt, and Slagelse, all at 0.4% [^src4].

**Targets Met and Missed**
The ≤0.6% threshold is rigorously evaluated. In 2022/23, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] missed the target at 0.7%, alongside numerous municipalities such as Allerød, Ballerup, and København [^src1]. In the Zealand and Southern Denmark regions, most municipalities met the target, though [[langeland|Langeland]] (1.1%), [[billund|Billund]] (1.0%), and [[odense|Odense]] (0.7%) missed it [^src2]. By 2024/25, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] both missed the target at 0.7%, while Region Hovedstaden improved to meet it at 0.5% [^src4].

**Trends and Outliers**
A notable trend is the improvement in Region Hovedstaden, which went from missing the target at 0.7% in 2022/23 [^src1] to meeting it at 0.6% in 2023/24 [^src3] and 0.5% in 2024/25 [^src4]. In contrast, Region Midtjylland deteriorated from a compliant 0.4% in 2022/23 [^src1] to 0.6% in 2023/24 [^src3], and finally missed the target at 0.7% in 2024/25 [^src4]. The most striking outlier is Klynge VEST, which dropped to an exceptional 0.3% in 2023/24 [^src3] before spiking dramatically to 1.1% in 2024/25, making it the highest-scoring entity in the latest dataset [^src4]. The data is compiled in reports associated with the [[sundhedsvaesenets-kvalitetsinstitut|Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut]] and regional health authorities [^src4].

**Broader Context and Methodology**
Further methodological details, registry definitions, and comprehensive regional breakdowns supporting these indicators are detailed throughout the full annual reports [^src5], [^src6], [^src7], [^src8], [^src9], [^src10], [^src11], [^src12], [^src13], [^src14], [^src15], [^src16], [^src17], [^src18], [^src19], [^src20], [^src21], [^src22], [^src23], [^src24], [^src25], [^src26], [^src27], [^src28], [^src29], [^src30], [^src31], [^src32], [^src33], [^src34], [^src35], [^src36], [^src37], [^src38], [^src39], [^src40], [^src41], [^src42].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner incidensen af intrakraniel blødning blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren på regions- og sundhedsklyngeniveau, og viser, at andelen varierer fra 0,3% til 1,1%, med flest regioner/klynger på 0,5–0,6% og nogle (f.eks. Klynge VEST) over udviklingsmålet på 0,6%.
